summary: Precision BioSciences filed an 8-K announcing the dosing of the first patient in its Phase 1/2 FUNCTION-DMD trial evaluating PBGENE-DMD for Duchenne muscular dystrophy at Arkansas Children's Hospital. This is a routine clinical progress update and a Regulation FD disclosure, not a special-situation corporate event. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic actions were disclosed. The filing includes a press release exhibit and standard regulatory disclosures. There is no deal structure, recommendation, or risk-arb angle; it is purely an operational milestone announcement.
